item.title: Said & Checked, Pennsylvania, 2026-11-18: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (John Joyce)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • John Joyce, U.S. Representative from Pennsylvania: “Last month, Blair County experienced the fourth train derailment since February of this year, which included cars carrying hazardous materials.” Unsettled. News reports describe four Blair County derailments from February to October 2026: February (about 65 cars, no hazmat release), March, August, and Oct. 23 in Altoona, the last including cars carrying hazardous materials. That matches the statement, but no FRA accident record could be read to confirm it.
